chunks.text: PMUY is a Government of India LPG connection scheme. The official site shows total connections released as of 04 May 2026 and highlights the latest PMUY extension.
To apply, locate your nearest LPG distributor and use the official PMUY application or KYC form. The site lists an LPG emergency helpline of 1906 and an Ujjwala helpline of 1800-266-6696.
